environment.description: Deployed on a standard EKS cluster with the application binary compiled with the hardcoded fallback key. KEY_PROVIDER environment variable is not set, so getSigningKey() returns the compile-time default. The attacker can read the key from the binary (strings extraction or decompilation), compute valid HMAC tokens for any user_id+channel_id pair, and subscribe to any channel by spoofing user_id in the WebSocket message.

config.network: Public ALB with no WAF, direct WebSocket passthrough
